Short answer (executive): Redwood supports account-scoped chronological audit exports that include sequential event IDs, monotonic timestamps, originator identity (internal role or external API key), model variant and routing metadata, and a cryptographic hash chain to establish sequence integrity. Typical turnaround for a full account export (30 days of activity) is 48–72 hours depending on retention tier and compliance packaging.

Jonas / Laura — draft runbook and clarifications below that we can paste into the RFP response. I kept the language procedural so auditors can follow steps.

RUNBOOK: Generate chronological account export (auditor-ready)
Pre-reqs: Service Admin role, Export API token, Customer account-id, Retention tier (standard/extended/enterprise), and any active legal-holds flagged on the account.

1) Validate account and permissions
  - API: GET /v1/accounts/{account_id}/audit/permissions
  - Confirm Service Admin and Export scope.
2) Create an export job
  - API: POST /v1/exports/audit-jobs
    payload: {"account_id": "ACME-12345", "start_ts": "2026-10-01T00:00:00Z", "end_ts": "2026-10-31T23:59:59Z", "format": "ndjson", "include_kv_cache_events": true}
  - Response includes export_job_id and estimated_completion_seconds.
3) Monitor job and integrity checks
  - API: GET /v1/exports/audit-jobs/{export_job_id}/status
  - Each exported file includes a SHA256 manifest entry; exports are signed by our HSM-held key for non-repudiation.
4) Download and verify
  - Once complete, files available for HTTPS download (signed URL) and can be transferred to S3 on the customer side via pre-signed links.
  - Verification: re-compute SHA256 and compare to manifest; use provided signature file and public certificate.
5) Chain-of-custody and preservation
  - Each event has sequence_id, event_ts (RFC3339), source_component, request_id, model_variant, and prior_hash. The prior_hash links to the previous event's SHA256 to form a verifiable chain.
  - For legal-hold: mark account.export_hold=true; this sets retention to immutable for the hold window and prevents garbage collection.

Retention notes:
- Standard tier: 90 days of full-fidelity audit logs, 2 years of aggregated summaries.
- Extended (enterprise): customer-configurable up to 7 years, cold-archive snapshots monthly.
- Legal hold: overrides retention tiers immediately, locks exported and on-platform logs in read-only mode until released by authorized legal admin.

Operational SLAs for exports (guidance):
- Small export (<=7 days): 24 hours
- Medium export (<=30 days): 48–72 hours
- Large export (>30 days or >100M events): 72–168 hours, dependent on throughput commitments and cold-archive retrieval.

Attachments referenced: redwood_audit_log_schema_v2.csv (field defs + sample rows), log-retention-diagram.png (archival flow), acme_rfp_attachment_matrix.xlsx (original matrix).
